title: Design Studio Selections Change Order Schedule Fee by Construction Stage
content:
The schedule fee of a fee-bearing change order on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the file status and the construction stage of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

- on a file that is structural closed while the agreement's construction stage is framing, drywall, finishes or complete, it is the package's post-structural change order fee times 1.5;
- on a file that is structural closed while the agreement's construction stage is foundation, it is the package's post-structural change order fee;
- on a file in any other status, it is the package's change order fee.

**Records read.** The file status on the design file; the current construction stage on the Home Purchase Agreement.

**Schedule fee by package (USD)**

| Package | File in any other status: package change order fee | Structural closed, stage foundation: post-structural fee | Structural closed, stage framing, drywall, finishes or complete: post-structural fee times 1.5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 350.00 | 750.00 | 1125.00 |
| Studio Classic | 350.00 | 750.00 | 1125.00 |
| Studio Select | 400.00 | 850.00 | 1275.00 |
| Studio Designer | 450.00 | 950.00 | 1425.00 |
| Studio Signature | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Studio Atelier | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 |

*Hypothetical case:* a Studio Select file in selection takes 400.00 whatever the construction stage; once the file is structural closed and the agreement shows drywall, it takes 850.00 times 1.5, that is 1275.00.
